_doc: Oathwild's spell catalogue. js/rules/spells.js is the ONE reader. An entry with no `from` and no `shape` is a REUSED row looked up by id in Farhold's skills.json, then Thousandvale's skills-tv.json `add`, then classes-tv.json `skills` (borrowed, never written). `from: "<source>:<id>"` reuses a row under a new id. `set` lays fields over the row (null removes one). An entry with `shape` is Oathwild's own. Fields the round-1 combat sim does not run are dropped when the row is read (js/rules/spells.js SUPPORTED) so nothing describes a rule that does nothing. `ranks` (WoW-style, bought with class points): rank 1 is the row; each later rank lists `power` (x on damage, heals, barriers, summons; buffs grow by half as much), `mp` (x on mana cost), optional `seconds` (added to what it applies), `cooldown` (x) and `add` (a new effect from that rank on). Missing `ranks` = `defaultRanks`. `school: song` makes a spell use Charisma; `powerFrom`: weapon | spell | heal | blend (average of weapon and spell power) | blendRanged.
